descriptionEn:
Hybrid role covering architecture, development and automation. I designed, implemented, and single-handedly deployed the entire Globatecnic microservices ecosystem on Proxmox VE, starting from a company with no prior infrastructure (everything from scratch): architecture, on-premise infrastructure, IAM, CI/CD, and all backend and frontend services.

Distributed architecture with 5 independent services: 3 Java Spring Boot backends with Clean Architecture / Hexagonal architecture, each with its own database, and 2 React TypeScript frontends with Feature-Sliced Design.

Corporate identity system (IAM) with JWT, RBAC (7 granular permissions), rate limiting, and brute-force protection. Transactional Outbox pattern with RabbitMQ for asynchronous synchronization between services.

Employee portal (clock-in/out with geolocation, PDF export) and administration portal (orders, proposals, attendance queries, PDF files), both as PWAs.

On-premise infrastructure on Proxmox VE with VLAN (DMZ + internal network), Nginx Proxy Manager as reverse proxy, 3 PostgreSQL 17 instances, and a shared Docker network between services.

Full CI/CD pipeline in Forgejo Actions (built from scratch): testing, multi-stage Docker builds, publishing to a private registry, and automated deployment to production.

Almost 500 automated tests (JUnit 5 + Vitest + Testing Library), technical documentation (ADRs, runbooks, architecture diagrams), and data seeding scripts.
descriptionEs:
Perfil híbrido: arquitectura, desarrollo y automatización. Diseñé, implementé y desplegué en solitario el ecosistema completo de microservicios de Globatecnic sobre Proxmox VE, partiendo de una empresa sin infraestructura previa (todo desde 0): arquitectura, infraestructura on-premise, IAM, CI/CD y todos los servicios backend y frontend.

Arquitectura distribuida con 5 servicios independientes: 3 backends Java Spring Boot con Clean Architecture / Hexagonal, cada uno con su propia base de datos, y 2 frontends React con TypeScript y Feature-Sliced Design.

Sistema de identidad corporativa (IAM) con JWT, RBAC (7 permisos granulares), rate limiting y protección anti-fuerza bruta. Patrón Transactional Outbox con RabbitMQ para sincronización asíncrona entre servicios.

Portal de empleados (fichajes con geolocalización, exportación PDF) y portal de administración (pedidos, propuestas, consulta de fichajes, ficheros PDF), ambos como PWA.

Infraestructura on-premise sobre Proxmox VE con VLAN (DMZ + red interna), reverse proxy Nginx Proxy Manager, 3 instancias PostgreSQL 17 y red Docker compartida entre servicios.

Pipeline CI/CD completo en Forgejo Actions (desde 0): test, build multi-stage Docker, publicación en registry privado y despliegue automático en producción.

Casi 500 tests automatizados (JUnit 5 + Vitest + Testing Library), documentación técnica (ADR, runbooks, diagramas de arquitectura) y scripts de poblado de datos.
